children: Cisco Systems reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $63.33B and diluted EPS of $3.33, versus $56.65B and $2.55 in fiscal 2025, as net income rose to $13.27B from $10.18B on strength across networking and AI-related demand.
¹ Reported as “Total revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted income per share”.
Total revenue rose 12% year-over-year, driven by 16% product growth and strong fourth-quarter momentum.
Hyperscaler demand surged: AI infrastructure revenue contribution increased to about 6% of total revenue versus under 2% previously, lifting orders for Cisco’s Silicon One products.
Networking led growth, with a 22% increase across AI infrastructure, data-center switching, wireless and servers.
Inventories and purchase commitments increased materially as the company scaled to secure memory and components and meet extended hyperscaler lead times.
Operating margin expansion funded reinvestment in silicon, optics, security and AI priorities.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
